verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Bolna MCP server that lets external assistants such as Claude or Cursor manage a Bolna account. That is the server role, not the voice agent consuming MCP servers as tool sources during a call. The Tools tab and the integrations page mention built-in tools but never MCP servers as a tool source for agents, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
